raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Financial Services Operations professional with 1.5+ years of experience in Fund Administration, Payment Processing, Reconciliation, and Investment Operations client/investor onboarding, account maintenance, payment processing, reconciliation, transaction management, data validation, and investment operations at SS&C Fintech Services. Skilled in payment processing, client onboarding, transaction lifecycle management, break resolution, and client servicing. Understanding of fund accounting processes with proven ability to meet SLA-driven environments.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Fund Operations & Reporting : Payment Processing, Transaction Management, Financial Reporting, Reconciliation, MIS Reporting. Compliance & Documentation: AML/KYC Verification, Regulatory Compliance, Legal Documentation Processing, Trust Deeds, Scheme Rules, Client Documentation Review Data Management & Controls: SOP Documentation, Data Validation, Quality Control Systems & Tools: Advanced Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, SUMIF, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting). Investment Operations: Basic Understanding of NAV, Capital Calls, Distributions, Corporate Actions, Financial Statement Preparation, Ratio Analysis
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate – Financial Services Operations Jan 2025 – July 2026
SS&C Fintech Services Ltd
Analyzed client onboarding documents and linked investor information to the appropriate fund while

ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal procedures. Coordinated with onshore teams to obtain and validate onboarding documentation for new investors and funds, ensuring all SLA and compliance requirements were met.
Maintained accurate records of investor subscriptions, withdrawals, holdings, and available fund balances,
ensuring timely updates to investor accounts.
Managed client/investor onboarding, reviewing and validating client information and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy.
Maintained investor/account information, including account updates, transaction-related changes and supporting


documentation. Performed reconciliation and investigated discrepancies/exceptions, supporting timely resolution within defined SLAs. Prepared daily and weekly operational reports on investor transactions, fund activities, and account balances for internal stakeholders and clients. Coordinated with onshore teams and internal stakeholders to resolve documentation gaps, transaction issues, and operational exceptions.
Validated client/entity master data and supporting documentation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy across



 
operational records. Processed investor account maintenance requests, including account updates and transaction-related changes, while maintaining high data accuracy. Performed quality checks on transaction records and supporting documentation to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and operational guidelines. Supported creation and maintenance of investor/trading accounts, ensuring accurate capture and validation of client information and account attributes. Supported SSI amendments and maintenance, ensuring accurate settlement-related account and beneficiary information. Processed and provided legal documentation, including Trust Deeds, Scheme Rules, and Member Nomination Forms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
Intern – Financial Services Operations
SS&C Fintech Services Ltd
Oct 2024 – Dec 2024
Assisted in processing financial transactions across diverse investment products, delivering critical support
for client and partner enquiries on UK-based products.
Validated and executed payment instructions, ensuring accurate processing, full compliance with internal
policies, and prompt resolution of payment exceptions.
Gained hands-on exposure to fintech compliance frameworks, fund administration workflows, and fund management systems; promoted to full-time Associate within 3 months in recognition of performance.
Management Trainee (Internship)
Thane Bharat Sahakari Bank Ltd (TBSB)
May 2023 – Jul 2023
Assist customers with check deposits, NEFT/RTGS transactions, passbook printing, and ATM-related services. Offered guidance to customers on account-related matters,including balance inquiries, transaction history, and account statements.
Managed fixed deposit renewal requests, coordinating with clients to renew their investments per their preferences. Maintained accurate records of fixed deposit maturity dates and interest calculations.
Assisted in day-to-day banking operations including loan disbursements, customer onboarding, and core
banking transaction support.
recognition in the Financial Services Operations team.
